Our Story

A village within the city.

✿

Tucked into the historic lanes of Saidpur, Des Pardes is where old Pakistan meets a modern table. Copper handis simmer over charcoal, tandoors glow beside stone walls, and every plate carries the warmth of a home kitchen — served in a garden strung with lights and the calm of the Margallas.

From Lahori karahis and Shinwari lamb to Hyderabadi biryani and slow-braised matka gosht, our menu is a passport across the subcontinent — cooked patiently, plated proudly.
